messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PD: #PD-9821 fired -> gpu-memory-pressure on cluster-west / pool: west-gpu-pool-7. Alert samples: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY, recurring allocator failures. Severity: P1. Please acknowledge and triage.

alex_sre: ack PD-9821. i'm pulling logs, paging onto zoom if needed. probably kv-cache pressure.

maria_oncall: oncall here — i see bursts of OOM from runtimes running llama2-70B-q4. rolling 5min spikes, a few evictions. customer-facing latency spike reported by observability.

alex_sre: running `kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=west-gpu-pool-7 -o wide` now. output looks like many pods in CrashLoopBackOff or OOMKilled.

sam_platform: heads-up — autoscaler tried to spin new nodes but they failed to allocate GPUs in time due to quota. i'm checking cloud quota + node taints.

alex_sre: paste of nvidia-smi from affected host:
```
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| NVIDIA-SMI 535.86.10   Driver Version: 535.86.10   CUDA Version: 12.1     |
| GPU  Name        Persistence-M| Bus-Id        Disp.A | Volatile Uncorr. ECC |
| 0   A100-SXM4-80GB    Off      | 00000000:3B:00.0 Off |                    0 |
+-------------------------------+-------------------------------------------+
| Processes:                                                                  |
|  GPU   GI   CI        PID   Type   Process name                  GPU Memory |
|        ID   ID                                     Usage              |
|  0     -    -      12345      C   python                           79921MiB |
|  0     -    -      23456      C   python                           1200MiB |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

alex_sre: big one consuming ~79GB on 80GB card + a few smaller procs. suspect memory leak or bad batching config for that model variant.

maria_oncall: tagging affected customers: customer-srv-88 shows increased 5xx and latency in last 3m. jen_csm, FYI.

jen_csm: on it, pinging account team. they reported real-time failures for embeddings and chat. asking for ETA and mitigation steps.

alex_sre: mitigation plan:
1) scale down model replicas for llama2-70B-q4 on west pool to reduce parallelism, set max_concurrency=1 for new requests.
2) drain the worst pod and restart processes with reduced batch_size.
3) if memory sustained, fallback router to smaller model variant (llama2-13B-q4) for non-SLA customers.

sam_platform: i can patch autoscaler config to allow burst capacity from a spare quota pool in us-west. doing a quick toggle for `max_burst_nodes=4`. will monitor.

alex_sre: executing drain/terminate on pod inference-llama2-70b-7k5: `kubectl drain pod inference-llama2-70b-7k5 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then delete to force restart.

incident-bot: PD-9821 acknowledged by alex_sre at 2026-03-14T03:45:34Z.

maria_oncall: restarted pod, new process memory at ~9GB, CPU healthy. traffic routed back gradually. observability shows tail latency improving after ~30s.

alex_sre: pushed runtime config change (reduced batch_size=4 -> 2) and lowered prefetch count for that model route. commit: git sha abc1234.

sam_platform: scaled node pool +3 GPUs from spare quota, one node failed to register due to driver mismatch, remedied by rolling driver version to 535.86.10. all new nodes registered.

jen_csm: told customer that we applied rollback to smaller model for lower-priority traffic and restarted affected workers; primary customers on SLA were prioritized. customer acknowledged and is monitoring.

maria_oncall: marking incident as mitigated for now: memory pressure reduced, no new OOMs in last 10m. keeping PD open for postmortem.

alex_sre: leaving detailed notes for postmortem. suspected root cause: unintended config change in rollout that increased default batch_size for llama2-70B-q4; allowlisting for big models missed in rollout guardrail. next actions: revert rollout rule, add automated load tests for extreme-prefetch cases, create alert to trigger before >70% GPU RAM sustained for 3m.

sam_platform: handing off to next oncall (maria_oncall stays until handoff window). adding runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-oom.

incident-bot: PD-9821 reassigned to oncall-shift-2 at 2026-03-14T04:20:50Z.

maria_oncall: handoff: i'll follow-up with postmortem doc and link to logs (s3://redwood-logs/pd-9821/) in the morning. leaving escalation steps in thread.

jen_csm: thanks team. keeping customer updated. please add a PS to ticket with timelines.

alex_sre: logged follow-ups: ticket INF-4512 (investigate batch-size rollout), INF-4513 (add pre-oom alert), INF-4514 (improve autoscaler quota fallback).

maria_oncall: last check: no new alerts for 12m. closing realtime pager; PD still open for RCA.

pagerduty-bot: PD-9821 status -> acknowledged -> mitigated -> pending postmortem.

alex_sre: +1 on RCA. assigning owners and ETA for remediation to next sprint.

maria_oncall: end of thread.
